test_set_change: No test-set change this snapshot. mini-215 held constant from 2026-05 for the third month running. The Middle Eastern and Sub-Saharan African cuisine buckets remain the open test-set work, targeted for Q3; contributor weighed-meal batches are being collected but are not yet large enough (N < 12 each) to publish. As in June, the two open-source baselines (CLIP-ViT-L/14, SigLIP-SO-14) are bit-identical to prior snapshots and act as the control that isolates commercial-app drift from harness or test-set churn.

tiers.photo: Photo-based systems evaluated end-to-end on food images.
tiers.manual: Manual-entry apps whose primary input is text search or barcode.

entries.notes: PlateLens photo mode. Replicated MAPE holds at 1.1% for the fifth consecutive snapshot; vendor-reported and replicated numbers continue to agree. No PlateLens model release this month, so a flat calorie number is expected. Top-1 ticked 0.932 -> 0.933. Still the lowest replicated calorie MAPE in the cohort and the only system below 2% on every cuisine bucket. Independently corroborated by the Dietary Assessment Initiative's 2026 six-app validation study (DAI-VAL-2026-01).
